name: Microsoft Planner
description: Microsoft Planner is a task and work management product for teams using Microsoft 365. People use it to organize plans, assign tasks, track dates and progress, and coordinate shared work through boards and schedules.
agentUseSummary: Connect Microsoft Planner through Relay-owned Microsoft work-account OAuth, then let agents inspect bounded assigned-task and explicit task or plan metadata through four fixed Graph wrappers. Relay excludes assignment identities, task details, group and directory discovery, writes, application or other-user access, exports, pagination, beta APIs, and raw Graph access.

capabilities.label: Read assigned tasks
capabilities.description: Review bounded Planner tasks assigned to the signed-in work account.

capabilities.label: Read explicit tasks and plans
capabilities.description: Inspect one prior-result task or plan and list bounded plan tasks.

allowed.label: List assigned tasks
allowed.description: List at most twenty-five privacy-bounded Planner tasks assigned to the signed-in work account.

allowed.label: Read task metadata
allowed.description: Read bounded metadata for one explicit prior-result Planner task without task details or assignment identities.

allowed.label: Read plan metadata
allowed.description: Read bounded metadata for one explicit prior-result Planner plan without group-directory expansion.

allowed.label: List plan tasks
allowed.description: List at most twenty-five privacy-bounded tasks for one explicit prior-result plan.

blocked.label: Read assignment identities or task details
blocked.description: Assignment identities, assignee resolution, descriptions, checklists, references, attachments, and task details are outside V1.

blocked.label: Discover groups or people
blocked.description: Group, roster, member, user, bucket, and directory discovery or expansion are outside V1.

blocked.label: Change Planner resources
blocked.description: Create, update, assign, complete, reorder, move, copy, and delete operations are outside V1.

blocked.label: Use broad or raw access
blocked.description: Application permissions, all-user access, exports, automatic pagination, beta APIs, and raw Graph access are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Four bounded delegated reads run automatically; identities, details, directory discovery, writes, application access, pagination, beta, and raw Graph remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same four delegated reads run without Relay per-action approval; exact scope, signed-in-user authority, limits, audit, redaction, and Microsoft controls still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts four bounded Planner read wrappers and attaches encrypted Microsoft tokens only on Railway.
Relay mounts four bounded Planner read wrappers and attaches encrypted Microsoft tokens only on Railway.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay still needs its Entra application registration, delegated Tasks.Read configuration, exact Railway callback, staging credentials, a licensed Planner work account, and Microsoft acceptance. Those provider-console and live-consent actions are outside this worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, configure the Relay-owned Entra application and exact callback, store its credentials on Railway staging, then verify licensed work-account consent, exact scope, PKCE/state, refresh rotation, signed-in-user binding, all four reads, privacy exclusions, throttling, revocation, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Microsoft Graph delegated authorization uses the v2 authorization-code flow, supports PKCE, and uses offline_access when a refresh token is required.
GET /me/planner/tasks lists tasks assigned to the signed-in work user and supports least-privileged delegated Tasks.Read.
Microsoft Graph provides an exact plannerTask read under delegated Tasks.Read.
Microsoft Graph provides an exact plannerPlan metadata read under delegated Tasks.Read.
Microsoft Graph provides a fixed plan-tasks collection endpoint under delegated Tasks.Read.
